scope: Density-only comparison within existing admissible label dates; no date widening, target change or keeper change
selection: Reuse the existing stable generation hash; initial h % 2 == 0; later h % 4 == 0. Existing later h % 32 == 0 is a subset.
probe_age: Preserve original requested_delay for every generation, including previously unselected rows. Do not recompute its age with the new sampling modulus.
evaluation: Keep the same old evaluation actions and their original 2/32 sampling weights to isolate a training-density change; new training rows use 2/4. Never relabel an old sampling probability silently.
safety: No outcome/fill/tail filtering. No duplicate action keys. Reconcile targets to the same engine and preserve every status. Do not combine incompatible continuations or bypass date boundaries.
weight_change: Replace assumptions of generation-only hardcoded weights with validated declared per-row inclusion probabilities; reject missing/incompatible sampling versions rather than silently mixing.
tests: Old selected actions are a subset and retain exact probe times.
Uniform hash positive control; invalid probability 0 or >1 refuses.
No train or decision input depends on outcomes.
First generations unchanged; rows unique by action identity.
Receipts preserve population/exclusions and source/input identities.
Matched evaluation controls retain their original selection mass.
prerequisites: Resolve pre-read boundary filtering and audit upstream clock provenance.
Qualify unknown-queue label assumptions; preserve or supersede old label definitions explicitly.
not_claimed: No eightfold increase in independent information or useful eligible labels is claimed.
No prediction improvement or model promotion is claimed.
